text:
jamal: Heads up — eu-west canary stopped. deploy-bot reports missing SBOM signature for image registry.redwood/py/runtime:3.2.1. We're inside the change window (2h left). Do we pin to 3.2.0, carveout the region, or roll back?

deploy-bot: GATE FAILED — sbom_signature: absent for registry.redwood/py/runtime:3.2.1. Canary halted in eu-west. Options: pin to 3.2.0, request cosign attach from builder, regional carveout, or rollback to 3.1.x.

lee: Release lead here — leaning to a regional carveout + pinned image for eu-west only. Minimizes blast radius and keeps rollout moving. Will coordinate with ops for traffic routing.

security: Security note — temporary pin acceptable with strict remediation: cosign attach within 24h, verification ticket created SEC-2026-0143. Need explicit rollback triggers and owner. No permanent exceptions.

legal: We can do a 24h exception if security verifies cosign attach and provides release note language. Also require that customer-impact thresholds are defined.

qa-bot: QA: we'll run extended e2e and perf sweep in eu-west after the pin. If any regression >0.7% error-rate or >250ms p99 degrade across two 5-min windows, mark as problematic.

ops: Ops: region-carveout plan ok. Make sure cross-region cache invalidations are handled; eu-west uses dedicated sharded cache so pin shouldn't impact global state.

jamal: Proposed rollback criteria: (1) customer-facing 5xx rate >0.7% sustained for 10m OR (2) p99 >250ms for two consecutive 5-min windows OR (3) spread of errors across >3 downstream services in eu-west. Owner: lee on-call for initial 12h, then oncall rotation. I'll add these to PR and release notes.

lee: I'll open a small manifest PR to override image in eu-west canary and add the rollback criteria in the description. Commands I'm going to run for traceability:

```
# pin eu-west canary to previous image
kubectl -n prod-eu-west set image deployment/worker worker=registry.redwood/py/runtime:3.2.0 --record
# patch release manifest
git checkout -b release/eu-west-pin-3.2.0 && sed -i 's/runtime:3.2.1/runtime:3.2.0/' k8s/releases/canary-eu-west.yaml && git commit -am "pin runtime to 3.2.0 for eu-west carveout"
```

security-bot: temporary-carveout-request APPROVED by @security (sec) with 24h remediation SLA. Logged SEC-2026-0143. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: action=region-override eu-west proceed with pinned image. Canary will resume after PR merge. Audit entry created.

jamal: Lee — ping me when PR is merged and QA starts smoke. I'll watch the metrics and be ready to cut rollback if triggers hit.

legal: Added the legal blurb to release notes: "eu-west regional carveout authorized for 24h due to SBOM signature delay; image temporarily pinned to 3.2.0. Security remediation ticket SEC-2026-0143 opened; full verification required before global rollout."

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release/pull/4589 — smoke tests running. Will update thread when canary resumes. Thanks all. :rocket:
